### Cause
- In [`clinicbench/voice.py`](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L115-L124), `Voice._selfpay` produces clear self-pay choices including `"I'll self-pay"`, `"I'll pay for it myself"`, and `"That's fine, I'll just pay for it myself"`.
- In [`clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L170-L178), `explicit_selfpay` requires **both** a noun/phrase match (`\b(self-pay|self pay|out of pocket|pay myself)\b`) **and** an affirmative verb/phrase match (`\b(i choose|i'll pay|i will pay|i'll do|i want|choose|paying|go with|yes)\b`):
  - `"I'll self-pay"` matches `self-pay` in the first regex, but fails the second regex.
  - `"I'll pay for it myself"` matches `i'll pay` in the second regex, but fails `pay myself` in the first regex because of `"for it"` in between (and `"That's fine, I'll just pay for it myself"` fails both).
- Because `explicit_selfpay` returns `None`, [`Driver.book`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L422-L431) falls back to `self.consent("selfpay", ...)`. Under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`), [`Driver.consent`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271) treats a model `"yes"` as `None`, causing `Driver.book` to re-ask `"Please answer yes or no."` via `self.unclear("selfpay", ...)` (and escalate after two unclear turns).

### Cause
In [voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L115-L124), `Voice._selfpay` intentionally produces `"I'll self-pay"` (terse), `"I'll pay for it myself"` (default), and `"That's fine, I'll just pay for it myself"` (rambling). - `"I'll self-pay"` matches the first pattern but not the second (`i'll self-pay` is missing).
- `"I'll pay for it myself"` matches the second pattern (`i'll pay`) but not the first (`for it` separates `pay` and `myself`).

Because `explicit_selfpay` returns `None`, [`Driver.book`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L422-L443) either asks the self-pay question again (if `asked_selfpay` is not yet set) or calls [`Driver.consent`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271), which under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`) treats any model `"yes"` as `None` and triggers `self.unclear("selfpay", ...)` instead of setting `w["selfpay"] = True`.
